BabySafeDrive+

Privacy policy

Effective October 17, 2026

This policy describes information handled by BabySafeDrive+ from NetanelVision. For privacy questions, contact netanelvision@gmail.com.

Reminder settings and local records

The app stores reminder text, selected days and times, driving detection settings and preferences on your device. It uses these records to run the reminders you configure. You do not need to create an account.

Location and driving detection

With your permission, the app uses location updates and speed information to detect driving and stopping. Always location access allows this functionality while the app is in the background. This information is processed on your device for reminders; the app does not automatically upload your location or driving history to NetanelVision. You can change location permissions in iPhone Settings. Disabling or limiting access affects driving reminders.

Notifications and charging state

The app schedules local notifications and sounds for reminders. Notification permission is controlled in iPhone Settings. If you enable the charging requirement, the app checks whether the phone is charging before arming a driving reminder.

Driving history

Local history records detected drive starts and ends, reminder events and acknowledgements, with timestamps and details such as speed or reminder text. When new events are recorded, the history is limited to 500 events and entries from the last 60 days. You can clear it from the Driving history screen.

Diagnostics and support email

The app keeps local diagnostic logs to help investigate problems. Logs may contain app activity, reminder details and technical information. When you use the in-app support email, it prepares an email to netanelvision@gmail.com with a diagnostic log attachment and app version, iOS version and device model information. The message is sent only when you send it. Review or remove attachments and text before sending.

If you contact us, we receive your email address, message and any attachments you send. We use them to respond and troubleshoot. Your email provider also processes the message under its own privacy policy.

Advertising and sharing

BabySafeDrive+ does not include advertising or third-party analytics in the version covered by this policy. We do not sell your app records or use them for advertising. Data you choose to send to support is handled to address your request.

Retention and deletion

Reminder settings remain on your device until you delete them or remove the app’s data. Deleting the app normally removes its local data, but copies may remain in device or iCloud backups according to your Apple settings. Manage those copies separately. Clearing driving history does not clear separate diagnostic logs or previously sent support emails.

Support correspondence is kept as needed to handle the request and related follow-up. Email us to request access, correction or deletion of information you have sent us. We cannot remotely delete information stored only on your device or in your personal backups.

This website

This website has no analytics scripts, advertising or tracking cookies. Its hosting provider, GitHub Pages, may process IP addresses and technical request logs to operate the service. See GitHub’s privacy statement.

Children and updates

The app is intended for parents and caregivers to operate. It does not require a child to provide personal information. Avoid including unnecessary personal information about children in reminder text or support messages. We may update this policy when the app or its data practices change; the effective date identifies the latest revision.
